DesperateSearchForMissingNewarkGirl: That's one of the title cards in this short about a woman thrown out after she has a child out of wedlock, with the usual "go and darken my doorstep no more!" gesture. Like many of the movies that tackled serious subjects in this era, it's not very good, between what can be said and shown and implied..... well, every age has its own beliefs in its own standards, no matter how hypocritical the passage of time may reveal them to be.I do like the very Gallic shrug the father gives at the end.

series:life-with-elizabeth-1953: Elizabeth and Alvin are a married couple who live an ordinary suburban life, but inevitably managed to get into predicaments. At the end of most predicaments, Alvin, in variable degrees of frustration, would say, "I shall leave you now, Elizabeth" and would walk out of sight. The announcer would say, "Elizabeth, aren't you ashamed?" She would slowly nod, but then, with a slightly devilish grin, would vigorously shake her head to indicate she wasn't.
